text.en: This radar stands beside the Tallinn-Harku weather station on the western edge of Tallinn and covers northern Estonia and the Gulf of Finland. A new radar on a 36 m lattice tower, 16 m taller than the old one, went online in December 2024; the wind farm at Paldiski still leaves streaks in its images.

Estonia's second weather radar stands at Sürgavere, north of Viljandi in the middle of the country, and covers southern Estonia and much of Latvia's north. The Vaisala dual-polarisation radar was ordered in 2007 together with the one at Harku and has run since 2008.
